'''Ice climbing''' was a form of entertainment enjoyed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. Icebergs were hauled from the planet's polar regions and floating offshore of the world's [[City/Legends|cities]]. Then, residents and tourists alike paid exorbitant sums of money to climb them. The sport caught on in a few of the planets in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] after being featured in several [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]].
